conflicts.description: Legacy sources disagree on label: 'ROM Started' versus 'Flasher - Jackpot'. Resolution path: this machine's own printed Solenoid/Flasher table, no copy of which is currently retained, or a LibPinMAME trace against a legal bop_l7 ROM observing whether public 19 pulses like a flasher or holds for the duration of a game; pinned core.h's WPC solenoid numbering and wpc.c's WPC_GILAMPS handling put this pre-Fliptronic generation's real game-on relay at public 31, inside the 29-31 state range rather than anywhere in the 1-28 driver range. Unresolved.
